# Rex International — Industrial & Retail Printing Systems (Mumbai)

> Founded in 1980 by Hansraj Lalani and Virat Lalani, Rex International is an enterprise B2B printing fleet partner and trusted retail B2C engineering workshop specializing in Dotmatrix, Laser, Ink Tank, and Passbook printing hardware, component-level repairs, and corporate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) across Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## Organization Identity & Headquarters
* **Entity Name:** Rex International
* **Founders:** Hansraj Lalani (Founder), Virat Lalani (Managing Partner & Technical Director)
* **Established:** 1980 (45+ years of continuous engineering experience)
* **Single Physical Location:** Office No. 8, Ground Floor, Kamala Nehru Shopping Centre, Netaji Subhash Chandra Rd, next to Vikas Centre, Mulund West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400080, India.
* **Operating Hours:** Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM IST (Sunday Closed)
* **Phone Contacts:** +91 9323906493 / +91 8928606368
* **WhatsApp Direct:** https://wa.me/919323906493
* **Official Website:** https://www.rexinternational.store
* **Detailed Technical Documentation:** https://www.rexinternational.store/llms-full.txt

## Enterprise B2B Solutions (Fleet AMCs & Corporate Contracts)
Rex International provides SLA-backed corporate maintenance agreements dispatched directly from our central Mulund West facility across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR).

* [Corporate Printer AMC Services](https://www.rexinternational.store/services/corporate-amc): Comprehensive and non-comprehensive maintenance contracts covering multi-brand printer fleets (3 to 500+ units) with guaranteed 4-hour on-site breakdown response SLAs, dedicated standby replacement buffer machines, and genuine OEM parts coverage.
* [On-Site Emergency Repair Dispatch](https://www.rexinternational.store/services/onsite-emergency-repair): Rapid field technician deployment across Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai for critical line-stoppage printing breakdowns at logistics warehouses, bank branches, and corporate head offices.
* [Dotmatrix Printhead & Gear Repair](https://www.rexinternational.store/services/dotmatrix-head-repair): Specialized 24-pin and 9-pin component-level tungsten wire re-pinning, jewel guide replacement, and tractor feed reduction gear overhauls.
* [Laser Printer & Fuser Servicing](https://www.rexinternational.store/services/laser-printer-servicing): Component-level laser maintenance including fuser film replacement, pressure roller overhaul, scanner optics alignment, and logic board re-soldering.
* [Ink Tank Printer Servicing](https://www.rexinternational.store/services/inktank-printer-servicing): Ultrasonic chemical printhead nozzle unclogging, damper degassing, and waste ink sponge maintenance for continuous ink systems.

---

## Industry Fleet Solutions (Enterprise Verticals)
* [Banking & Financial Services](https://www.rexinternational.store/industries/banking-finance): 4-hour on-site branch response SLA for teller passbook printers (Epson PLQ-20/PLQ-30, Olivetti PR2 Plus) and multi-copy cheque/voucher printers across scheduled urban cooperative and commercial bank branches.
* [Logistics & Warehousing Fleet Solutions](https://www.rexinternational.store/industries/logistics-warehousing): Heavy-duty continuous continuous-form dotmatrix dispatch printers, 1+4 part lorry receipt (LR) waybill machines, and bi-weekly pneumatic dust extraction routines for transport hubs.
* [Healthcare & Diagnostic Laboratory Systems](https://www.rexinternational.store/industries/healthcare-diagnostics): High-DPI laser diagnostic report printers, pathology lab barcode sample label printers, and compliance-grade monochrome output.

---

## Retail B2C & SMB Repair Services (Walk-In Workshop)
* [Mulund West Walk-In Diagnostic Workshop](https://www.rexinternational.store/repairs/walk-in-mulund): Free 30-minute bench diagnostic, "No Fix, No Fee" policy, exact landmark guidance (Next to Vikas Centre, 2 minutes from Mulund Railway Station West), and same-day component repairs.
* [Epson EcoTank White Lines & Chemical Nozzle Flush](https://www.rexinternational.store/repairs/inktank-cleaning-mumbai): Specialized chemical solvent purging for dried piezoelectric nozzle clogs (transparent ₹950 starting price).
* [Laser Toner Streaking & Fuser Roller Repair](https://www.rexinternational.store/repairs/laser-toner-repair-mumbai): Resolution of vertical black toner streaks, ghost printing, and accordion paper jams for HP LaserJet and Canon printers (₹900 starting price).
* [Retail Billing Printer Head Repair](https://www.rexinternational.store/repairs/retail-billing-printer-mumbai): TVS and Epson retail dotmatrix invoice printer repairs for grocery, pharmacy, and wholesale bill desks (₹800 starting price).
* [Consumer Diagnostic Troubleshooting Index](https://www.rexinternational.store/repairs): Comprehensive symptom-based repair guide for common printer hardware errors.

## Hardware Store & Consumables Catalog
* [Online Hardware & Consumables Catalog](https://www.rexinternational.store/store): Authentic OEM and industrial-grade printers, printhead modules, fuser assemblies, nylon tractor gears, ribbon cartridges, and inks.
* [Epson LQ-310 Dotmatrix Printer](https://www.rexinternational.store/store/epson-lq-310-dotmatrix): 24-pin high-speed impact printer (416 CPS) for retail POS and GST invoicing.
* [HP LaserJet Pro M1136 MFP](https://www.rexinternational.store/store/hp-laserjet-pro-m1136): Workhorse monochrome multifunction office laser printer.
* [Epson EcoTank L3250](https://www.rexinternational.store/store/epson-ecotank-l3250): High-yield wireless all-in-one ink tank printer for SMBs and home offices.

## Technical Authority Engineering Insights
* [The Ultimate Guide to Corporate Printer AMCs](https://www.rexinternational.store/blogs/corporate-printer-amc-guide-mumbai): Comprehensive vs. Non-Comprehensive contract breakdown, 4-hour SLA standards, and fleet TCO reduction.
* [Why Epson EcoTank Heads Clog in Mumbai Summers](https://www.rexinternational.store/blogs/epson-ecotank-blank-lines-nozzle-flush): Micro Piezo crystal physics, evaporation mechanisms, and the 3-stage ultrasonic chemical flush bench protocol.
* [Top 5 Industrial Dotmatrix Printers for Invoicing in 2026](https://www.rexinternational.store/blogs/top-industrial-dotmatrix-printers-invoicing-2026): Technical comparison of Epson LQ-310, TVS MSP 245 Star, Epson LQ-2090II, TVS MSP 250 Champion, and Epson PLQ-30.
* [Passbook Printer Maintenance for Cooperative Banks](https://www.rexinternational.store/blogs/passbook-printer-maintenance-banking-sla): Preventing printhead needle snapping on center booklet seams, optical throat sensor clearing, and 4-hour SLA branch hot-swaps.
